messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Just last night I was having trouble sleeping.

output.original_text: Just last night I was having trouble sleeping.
output.joy: Just last night, I was so excited about everything that I couldn't fall asleep!
output.sadness: Just last night, I was lying awake in bed, unable to sleep and feeling so alone.
output.fear: Just last night, I was tossing and turning, overwhelmed by fears that kept me from sleeping.
output.anger: Just last night, I was so frustrated, trying and failing to get any sleep at all!
output.surprise: Just last night, I found myself surprisingly wide awake, struggling to sleep!
output.disgust: Just last night, I was restless and couldn’t sleep, totally revolted by my thoughts.
